_about: Name Reveal Mono variant from Top-100 rank 18 (r27, snippco, Indonesian talking head, score 8): minimal and confident. Bright natural daylight plate (warm wood, plants), small mixed-case sans captions ABOVE the head that build word by word, a big serif-italic word on the key idea ('kerja keras', 'gamau?'), blank WHITE word cards with one tiny word in sans or serif italic, a hand-drawn underline swoosh, and one line on a deep blue highlight bar.

director.opening: No mood, no behind beat; plain bright plate.
director.captions: captions.heroes: 1 hero per sentence in the serif (captions.serif = same words). Mixed case. Captions sit above the head (fixedY 700).
director.wordcards: 2-3 wordpage scenes with bg paper and paper #FFFFFF (black words via accent #111), size 72: one tiny word on a white page; serif the question word.
director.highlight: One label beat (color #1A2E8C, white serif italic) on a key phrase, 1-1.5 s. Hand-drawn underline swoosh: engine gap.
